content.bridge_context: Comparing two quantities using Ratios and Percentages.

units.title: What is a Ratio?
units.explanation: A ratio compares two quantities of the same kind by division (e.g., 2:3).
units.dual_language_instruction: Express 5km to 500m as a ratio. / 5 किमी और 500 मीटर का अनुपात व्यक्त करें।

units.title: Percentage
units.dual_language_instruction: Convert 1/4 to percentage. / 1/4 को प्रतिशत में बदलें।
